extension.summary: Una skin minimalista de diseño horizontal
extension.description: Arctic Fuse 3 is a minimal row based skin with customisable widgets
Arctic Fuse 3 es una skin minimalista de diseño horizontal con widgets personalizables
Arctic Fuse 3 ist ein minimalistisches, zeilenbasiertes Skin mit anpassbaren Widgets
Arctic Fuse 3 是一款采用简约行式布局的 Kodi 皮肤，支持小组件自定义功能
Arctic Fuse 3 سكن مخفف بقوائم افقية وبامكانية تخصيص الاختصارات
extension.news:
v3.15.1 - Show only the artwork, title, artist and album on the music screen. The progress bar, track times, playing label and clock return with the music OSD.
v3.15.0 - Keep the image-path recovery step pending until the skin runs again. - List four previously missing optional dependencies in skin settings. - Colour PVR guide genres from backend genre codes with a neutral fallback. - Fall back to the default folder icon for missing optional add-on icons. - Refresh seek bar chapter markers and remove unused skin definitions.
v3.14.0 - Move the full-height media list count to the bottom left with a hairline. - Keep the list name at the top and retain the taller list. - Update the full-height view preview.
v3.13.1 - Keep the playback timeline below the full-height OSD track list and details.
v3.13.0 - Show the music folder or playlist name and count above the full-height list. - Reduce the left margin and extend the library, playlist, and OSD track lists. - Update the full-height view preview.
v3.12.0 - Show an accurate preview for Media List (Full Height). - Require the image package that contains the new preview.
v3.11.0 - Add Media List (Full Height) as the song default and an optional view for other media. - Restore the title header and standard height for the original Media List.
v3.10.1 Remove stray separators from music information.
v3.10.0 Show artist and album on the music OSD. Add the persistent song information setting to Playback settings. Default song lists to the full-height Media List view.
v3.9.3 - Show song titles with artists in simple lists and widgets. - Include song artist and album in detailed widget labels. - Correct Pink and Blue background paths and repair saved Pink selections.
v3.9.2 - Fit two-line widget titles with the large text font. - Keep settings-level text clear at large font sizes.
v3.9.1 - Preserve the three default icons required by Skin Variables.
v3.9.0 - Publish image assets as a separate dependency and migrate saved image paths. - Add an optional large text font and clarify the advanced settings control.
v3.8.9 - Internal cleanup of home widget focus handling; no visible change.
v3.8.8 - Pressing Down on a Poster, Card, Circle, Banner or Board widget row reaches the rows below again: the labels-below spacer under those rows had no control ID, which broke the widget list's Down/Up chain (for example Discover stopped at Popular and Home stopped at New Shows).
v3.8.7 - Opening the view picker (DialogSelect in viewtype mode), the game filter dialogs or the text viewer no longer logs "Skin has invalid include" on every open.
v3.8.6 - Card row view with titles on: the posters beside the card keep their shape, and the card keeps the usual gap to the next poster. - Combined widgets on hubs and in search follow Text labels (Off hides square and landscape titles), and their loading placeholders draw title bars only where the row has titles. - Skin users keep their menus and widgets after a skin update instead of losing them until the next login. - With the weather fanart pack installed but disabled, the weather screens no longer try to read it and log "GetDirectory - Error getting resource://...".
v3.8.5 - The first start after installing or updating the skin no longer logs "Skin has invalid include" and "GetDirectory - Error getting include": until the menus and widgets are built, the skin ships empty stand-ins for them. - With the Arctic Waves (or weather fanart) image pack installed but disabled, the busy animation and the start-up images no longer try to read it and log "GetDirectory - Error getting resource://...".
v3.8.4 - Combined row views: while a row loads, poster, circle and board placeholders no longer draw title bars (those rows show no titles), so the bars no longer reach into the "N items" footer. - Combined square and landscape rows follow Text labels: Off now hides their titles.
v3.8.3 - The card row view no longer draws the "N items" footer over the titles under its tiles: with titles on, the card and the posters beside it get a little smaller, as in the other row views.
v3.8.2 - Row views (poster, circle and board rows, such as Sets) no longer draw the "N items" footer over the second line of the first tile's title: with titles on, the tiles get a little smaller, as on the walls.
v3.8.1 - Wall and Combined widget layouts load widgets as you reach them: the selected widget and its neighbours load first, the rest when you move to them, so opening a hub no longer starts every widget's add-on at once. Widgets that turn out empty still drop out of the widget selector. - Wall-mode widgets show titles under their tiles like the library walls and follow Text labels (Off, Simple, Detailed); their loading placeholders match. - Poster, circle and board walls keep whole rows with titles on: the tiles get a little smaller instead of the rows getting taller, so the second row's titles are no longer cut off at the bottom. Circle wall titles are centred. - Poster Wall Details shows three whole rows with titles on or off; the third row is no longer cut off. - Row views: the scrollbar sits below the tile titles instead of over them. - Widget rows and info dialog rows with titles under poster, card, circle, banner and board tiles now really get their extra row space. - The skin rebuilds its widget layouts once after this update; nothing to do.
v3.8.0 - Every widget style now shows titles under its tiles: circle, card, banner and board rows join poster, landscape and square. Skin settings, Text labels (Off, Simple, Detailed) applies to all of them, and loading placeholders follow it too. - Library views label their tiles the same way: poster, circle and board walls and rows, and the Poster Wall Details view (centred titles). Walls with titles under the tile get a little taller rows; Text labels Off restores the old spacing. - Cast and crew rows no longer leave an empty gap under the posters. - Poster tiles show the watched-progress line like the other tile styles. - The Poster Wall Details side panel, the music OSD title and the next-item previews (video and music) now use the same title, info line and plot styles as the rest of the skin. - Up next previews: no more stray bullets or dashes, "Up next in 12s" on the Next Track overlay, and the video preview shows the premiere date instead of a raw rating. - Episode numbers are zero-padded everywhere (1x05), "Ends at" and the watched-episodes wording are the same everywhere, and channel, stream and duration details read the same in every dialog.
- No changes to the skin; this release only updates the developer build guide.
v3.7.0 - Skin settings, Text labels now has a third choice, Off: no labels under any widget for an artwork-only look (poster rows also drop their extra label space). Simple shows titles and Detailed shows titles with a subtitle. Takes effect after Home or the hub reloads.
v3.6.1 - Poster widgets now label their items like the other widget styles: the title under each poster, plus the subtitle line when Skin settings, Text labels is Detailed. Poster rows get a little more room to fit them.
v3.6.0 - Poster widgets show each title under its poster when Skin settings, Text labels is set to Detailed.
v3.5.3 - The music OSD's Next button preview now works for all music (library and Plex too), not only Spotify.
v3.5.2 - The next-track preview shown on the music OSD's Next button now shows album art as a rounded square instead of a cropped landscape tile; the video preview stays landscape.
v3.5.1 - Fix hubs showing no title or info while the menu has focus when the first widget is disabled, blank or empty: the info now comes from the first row that has items.
v3.5.0 - While music or a video plays, the menus now step aside after 60 seconds without input and bring the playback back to fullscreen, so a menu never stays on screen for hours (kinder to OLED screens). Change the delay or turn it off in Skin settings, Playback. It never interrupts typing, settings, questions or a running task.
v3.4.0 - Next Track now shows its upcoming-track overlay on every screen, not only the music visualisation. It is display only: menus, navigation and buttons keep working underneath it. - Fix trailers playing behind the info screen: starting a trailer now closes the info dialog so the trailer plays fullscreen on top.
v3.3.5 - Fix hubs (Home, Discover and the others in Standard mode) showing only artwork while the main menu has focus: the first row's title and info are back above the rows (regression in 3.3.0).
v3.3.4 - Remove compiled test files committed by mistake in 3.3.3; nothing in the skin changes.
v3.3.3 - The publish checks run the skin's tests again; nothing in the skin changes.
v3.3.2 - Lighter widget rows: the focused item of each row is drawn once instead of twice (same look), roughly halving its per-frame work.
v3.3.1 - The "Add to Watchlist" / "Remove from Watchlist" button labels can now be translated.
v3.3.0 - Home and hub widget rows past the third now load as you approach them, so the first rows (and other windows) appear faster; rows not reached yet show a spinner. - Returning to Home no longer re-runs the shortcut build script unless shortcuts, the skin user or the skin version changed. - Standard widget mode shares one info panel across rows (about half the controls on Home); it is empty while the top bar has focus. - Poster wall details: genre is a static line instead of a scrolling label that kept the GPU busy.
v3.2.76 - Watchlist button on Discover items shows "Remove from Watchlist" immediately when the item is already in your Watchlist (uses PlexKodiConnect's hint until it confirms).
v3.2.75 - Add publish rule checks (pre-push hook and CI workflow); nothing in the add-on changes.
v3.2.74 - Test-only: let the packaging test run from a source archive (no change to the skin).
v3.2.73 - Merge 51 upstream Arctic Fuse fixes (hub preload cycling, OSD progress line, translations). - Fix empty icon selector with stock script.skinvariables. - Stop the post-update recovery from closing dialogs and jumping to Home unless the window is actually broken (never during playback). - Keep the Spotify "Next" overlay visible when focusing Next in the music OSD. - Watchlist Add/Remove for items without a Plex or TMDb ID (needs PlexKodiConnect 3.12.58). - Fix library TV shows in combined side panels showing specials/empty after a PKC sync. - Drop the always-empty "Plex: Trending Trailers" widget preset. - Poster wall details: no stray leading dot when Premiered is missing.
v3.2.72 - Fix missing default background blur image (purle_blur typo). - Use dialog styling for colour-picker settings in dialogs.
v3.2.71 - Add Claude Code project settings (not packaged).
v3.2.70 - Fix Down on the Wall Poster - Details A-Z rail from a non-alpha (#) item so it lands on the first letter section instead of skipping to the end. - Only show the Wall Poster - Details A-Z rail for alphabetical sorts and fall back to the standard wall scrollbar otherwise. - Fix the missing main-menu highlight texture, settings info line, Settings hub onload and window-change animation conditions. - Remove dangling control references in Favourites, PVR guide, PVR channel guide and video info windows.
v3.2.69 - Play trailers with Kodi's normal fullscreen trailer playback flow.
v3.2.53 - Keep TMDb Helper Watchlist detail dialogs open and switch Add/Remove state immediately while PKC verifies Plex in the background. - Use PKC's native per-item Plex Watchlist state for the button label and icon instead of relying on the current listing. - Replace the detail action glyphs with focused PNG states for Play, Add to Watchlist, and Remove from Watchlist. - Include the latest Icon Selector sorting and category improvements.
v3.2.51 - Package the default Skin Variables generated-include fallback so Arctic Fuse 3 can always load after an update or restart. - Package the empty skin timer definition required by Kodi during Arctic Fuse startup.
v3.2.50 - Run the TMDb Helper Watchlist command before closing its detail dialog, preserving the exact TMDb ID for PKC.
v3.2.49 - Send TMDb Helper Watchlist actions to PKC with the exact TMDb ID instead of title and year. - Add a Plex Discovery shortcut backed by PKC's native Plex Discover browser.
v3.2.21 - Restore the original Wall Poster info header when the details variant is also available.
v3.2.20 - Split the poster wall details design into a separate Wall Poster - Details view variant.
v3.2.19 - Add a poster wall details layout with visible titles, alphabet rail navigation, and corner-safe watched indicators.
v3.2.18 - Hide the fullscreen busy spinner once video playback has media and is no longer caching.
v3.2.17 - Add tenth-percent PKC skip marker fill frames for smoother countdown motion.
v3.2.16 - Render the PKC skip marker countdown as a 12px-radius background fill instead of a separate progress line.
v3.2.15 - Move the PKC skip marker OSD pill to the lower-right viewing area and use a smooth progress countdown.
v3.2.14 - Add a PKC marker-aware OSD skip action for intro, credit, and commercial markers.
v3.2.13 - Add a post-update skin reload recovery service so active Arctic updates return Kodi to Home instead of leaving the UI black or stranded on a destroyed window.
v3.2.12 - Prevent live skin-update reloads from rerunning the startup splash and hub preloading flow, which could leave Kodi without a usable UI.
v3.2.11 - Fix Spotify music OSD next-track overlay focus so hovering the next button keeps a real skip-next control active.
v3.2.10 - Primez branch metadata/version bump for repository auto-updates.
